content.user_title: Build MongoDB Lexical, Vector, and Hybrid Search
content.value_statement: Choosing search indexes and query patterns becomes difficult when applications need keyword relevance, semantic similarity, and filtering. This skill guides MongoDB search design, prerequisite checks, and query refinement through documented workflows and MongoDB MCP tools.
actual_capabilities: Recommend lexical, manual vector, automated embedding, or hybrid search based on retrieval requirements.
Guide schema, index, and MongoDB version inspection through MongoDB MCP tools.
Draft lexical search indexes with analyzers, field mappings, autocomplete, synonyms, and stored source.
Construct vector queries with matching dimensions, similarity functions, filters, and candidate limits.
Design rank-based or score-based hybrid pipelines and explain their compatibility requirements.
Request approval before index creation and provide complete configurations when write tools are unavailable.
limitations: Live inspection and query execution require a configured MongoDB MCP server and appropriate database permissions.
Feature availability depends on MongoDB version, deployment, cluster configuration, and current service requirements.
Manual vector search requires existing embeddings; automated embedding is text-only and involves model processing with possible usage charges.
The skill provides retrieval guidance, not a complete RAG application or guaranteed relevance, recall, or latency.

use_cases.title: Improve Product Catalog Search
use_cases.description: Design autocomplete, typo-tolerant matching, category filters, and facets for a MongoDB product catalog.

use_cases.title: Plan Semantic Document Retrieval
use_cases.description: Compare existing embeddings with automated embedding and define filtered retrieval for a document collection.

use_cases.title: Tune Search Indexes and Queries
use_cases.description: Review mappings, stored source, pagination, candidate counts, and query plans to address slow or incomplete search results.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Search Approach
prompt_templates.prompt: My MongoDB collection stores [data type], and users need [search behavior]. Recommend a search approach and ask about missing prerequisites before proposing changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: selecting lexical or semantic retrieval.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Lexical Search Index
prompt_templates.prompt: For [collection], search [text fields] with autocomplete and filter by [filter fields]. Inspect existing mappings and propose an index without creating it.

prompt_templates.title: Configure Semantic Retrieval
prompt_templates.prompt: Design semantic retrieval for [collection] using [existing embeddings or automated embedding]. Check compatibility, dimensions, filters, data-processing requirements, and costs before proposing execution.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate a Hybrid Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [current pipeline] for hybrid search over [collection]. Verify fusion support, propose weights and candidate limits, and plan relevance and latency tests.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: optimizing combined lexical and vector retrieval.

output_examples.input: Add autocomplete and category filters to my product collection.
output: Recommendation: use Atlas Search with an autocomplete mapping for product names and a token mapping for categories.
Validation: inspect the existing schema and indexes before selecting field mappings.
Next step: present the proposed index configuration and request approval before creation.

output_examples.input: Find similar documents without managing an embedding pipeline.
output: Recommendation: evaluate automated embedding for the document text field and add filter fields for scoped retrieval.
Prerequisites: verify deployment support, required cluster settings, model processing, and current usage charges.
Validation: wait for index readiness, then evaluate representative queries and retrieval quality.

output_examples.input: Our lexical and semantic searches return different results.
output: Recommendation: evaluate rank-based fusion after checking MongoDB version compatibility.
Query review: limit each input pipeline and adjust candidate counts to improve overlap.
Evaluation: compare combined rankings and latency against representative queries before changing production behavior.

best_practices: Inspect schema, existing indexes, deployment requirements, and MongoDB version before designing a search solution.
Approve index changes explicitly and review embedding data processing and costs before enabling automated embedding.
Use explicit production mappings, scoped filters, and bounded results; measure retrieval quality and latency with representative queries.
anti_patterns: Creating indexes without approval or assuming write permissions are available.
Mixing embedding models or dimensions between stored vectors and query vectors.
Using unsupported fusion stages or leaving lexical input pipelines without result limits.

faq.question: Which search approaches does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers Atlas lexical search, manual vector search, automated embedding, and hybrid retrieval with rank or score fusion.

faq.question: Does it require a MongoDB MCP server?
faq.answer: Live inspection and execution require MongoDB MCP tools. The skill can still explain approaches and draft configurations without database access.

faq.question: Will it create indexes automatically?
faq.answer: The workflow requires explicit approval before index creation. Without write tools, it provides the configuration for manual creation.

faq.question: Can I use embeddings from my own model?
faq.answer: Yes. Manual vector search uses existing embeddings, with query vectors matching the indexed model, dimensions, and similarity requirements.

faq.question: Does automated embedding have privacy or cost considerations?
faq.answer: Yes. The guide describes Voyage AI model processing, hosting, and token billing. Review current requirements and organizational data policies before enabling it.

faq.question: Can I use this with Claude and Codex?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code support. Actual tool availability depends on your configured MongoDB MCP integration.
